zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: 波音完成737-7與737-10認證飛行測試
zh.summary: 波音公司於2026年7月28日確認，旗下737 MAX 7與737 MAX 10客機已完成預定的認證飛行測試。該計畫目前轉向完成開發保證審查與系統安全評估，並提交至美國聯邦航空局審查。波音重申兩款機型仍預計於2026年取得認證，並於2027年開始交付。
body: 波音（Boeing）公司於2026年7月28日確認，旗下737-7與737-10客機已完成預定的認證飛行測試。其中737 MAX 10在測試期間共累計執行976架次飛行、超過2060小時飛行時數，以及約1040小時地面測試時數。
隨著認證飛行測試告一段落，該計畫作業重心已轉向完成剩餘的開發保證審查（DAR）與系統安全評估（SSA），並將最終交付文件提交給美國聯邦航空局（FAA）進行監管審查。波音指出，目前DAR 3已完成，DAR 4完成度為60%，系統安全評估則已完成32%。
波音團隊重申，737-10與737-7兩款機型仍按原定計畫推進，預計於2026年獲得監管機構認證，並於2027年正式開始向客戶交付。

en.title: Boeing Completes Planned Certification Flight Testing for 737-7 and 737-10
en.summary: Boeing confirmed on July 28, 2026, that it has completed planned certification flight testing for both the 737-7 and 737-10 aircraft variants. The 737 MAX 10 testing campaign logged 976 flights and over 2,060 flight hours. The program is now shifting focus toward closing development assurance reviews and system safety assessments before submitting final deliverables to the Federal Aviation Administration. Boeing reaffirmed that both aircraft remain on track for certification in 2026 and customer deliveries starting in 2027.
body: Boeing confirmed on July 28, 2026, that certification flight tests for the 737-7 and 737-10 aircraft variants reached their conclusion. The planned 737 MAX 10 certification flight testing logged 976 flights, over 2,060 flight hours, and about 1,040 ground test hours.

With flight testing finished, the program is shifting to closing remaining development assurance reviews and system safety assessments before submitting final deliverables to the Federal Aviation Administration for regulatory review. Boeing reported DAR 3 is finished, DAR 4 is 60 percent complete, and system safety assessments are 32 percent complete.
Boeing reaffirmed that the 737-10 and 737-7 remain on schedule for regulatory certification in 2026, with initial customer deliveries planned for 2027.
